Liter Tratamento de Água.note: Liter Tratamento de Água operates as an independent company specializing in water treatment and reverse osmosis systems in Brazil.

Mayim Soluções em Água.note: The company is independently operated by L. Machiavelli Fanini Comercio e Serviços de Equipamentos and there is no record of an acquisition.

Othein Industria.note: Othein Industria operates independently as a manufacturer of water purification equipment with no record of acquisition.

Pollycall.note: Pollycall is an active, privately held Brazilian company operating independently as Pollycall Comércio e Serviços LTDA with no record of acquisition.

TEGA Engenharia.note: TEGA Engenharia is an independent Brazilian industrial water and wastewater treatment engineering company operating since 2004 with no history of acquisition.

VDR Indústria e Comércio de Filtros Ltda.note: The company remains an independent privately held entity operating under its own brand in Brazil.

Yete Ambiental.note: Yete Ambiental operates as an independent company with no verifiable history of acquisition by another firm.

Indfiltros.note: Indfiltros operates as an independent manufacturer and distributor of industrial and reverse osmosis filtration components in Brazil.
